title: Abayili beLitye
intro: Khawucinge ngempucuko enamandla, eneziphiwo zamandla nezakhono, ikrola izindlu ezinkulu kwiintaba. Eli qela lalinobutyebi obukhulu kunye nobuchule obukhethekileyo bokwakha. Nangona befumene izilumkiso ezicacileyo, bakhetha indlela eya kukhokelela kwisiphelo esimangalisayo nesingenakulibaleka. Ngaba ungalibona eli qela elibali lalo lisebenza njengesifundo esibalulekileyo kubo bonke abacingayo?
clues: Sanikwa amandla nobuchule, nto leyo eyasenza sakwazi ukuzoba izindlu ezintle ngqo ezintabeni.
Sanikwa uphawu olucacileyo oluvela ku-Allah, isidalwa esikhethekileyo esasingaphazanyiswa ukuba sidle.
Uluntu lwethu lwaba nekratshi, luphikisa umyalezo kaThixo oziswa ngumthunywa ovela phakathi kwethu.
Saceba ukwenzakalisa umqondiso omangalisayo, nangona sasilumkisiwe ngesohlwayo esiqatha.
Asizange siwuthobele umyalelo wokuvumela esi silwanyana sikhethekileyo ukuba sisele equleni lethu ngeentsuku ezitshintshanayo.
Sifikelele esiphelweni esibuhlungu, sabethwa kukuqhuma okukodwa, okoyikisayo emva kwesenzo sethu sokungathobeli umthetho.
arabic: فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verse: And the punishment seized them. Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers. (26:158)
